name: TimePicker
description: Clock-time and duration fields opening digit-field sheets (hour/minute/second plus AM/PM, day/hour/minute/second) in a dialog or a popover, wired into the form system.

fields.mode: PromptMode? - dialog or popover presentation; null = dialog
fields.dialogTitle: Widget? - title of the dialog prompt; null = none

notes: The formatter component dep (TimeFormatter, single owner) is imported, not re-declared, per the batch bug note.
The form component dep from the batch plan is consumed as the form_core primitive (ObjectFormField/PromptMode, single owner); no form-component import was needed.
The text dep from the batch plan was not needed: captions are plain widgets Text.
Material TimeOfDay/Icons/TextField are the foundation value, lucide icons and the input component (validator gets raw text per the input pilot).
The zero-reader TimeRange is deleted; the AM/PM Toggle is two Buttons (toggle is not a listed dep).
Digit fields clamp into range on every edit (hour 0-23, minute/second 0-59, days 0-9999) via date_math ranges.
